work_item: B04 ordered projection of selected root-object JSON fields through Core
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of the compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json

tests_and_route.reason_not_executed: No tests or runtime/ordinary CLI verification were requested or run in this implementation slice; formatting, compilation, lint and build checks only were run.

implemented_route: apps/cli -> Core::run -> input::structured_intent -> Intent::JsonObjectProject -> ports::json_object_project -> JsonObjectProjectReport artifact; Core renders report.json
supported_behavior: The operation requires one complete valid root JSON object; duplicate decoded JSON keys are rejected by the shared parser.
The selected field list must contain 1..256 unique names and every requested field must exist at the root. Fields are emitted in caller order.

Selected value JSON lexemes are copied byte-for-byte into the projected object. Output names are encoded JSON strings; the source-map artifact retains original key/value byte ranges and SHA-256 values plus output byte ranges and JSON Pointers.
Input, projection output, source map and Core request evidence are bounded; invalid root shape, missing/duplicate fields and limit overflow suspend with typed failures.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; source implementation and format/check/lint/build evidence only, no test or ordinary-route execution
